answers.answer_text: This condition" refers to Condition 2 in SRS-010: the current temperature has moved outside the trigger band but is still within the overtemperature bounds -- LO <= T < LT (needs heating) or UT < T <= UO (needs cooling). It is the condition indicating a unit must be turned on, as distinct from Condition 1 (LT <= T <= UT), where the setting is satisfied and both units are turned off.

This module" is the Determine H/C Mode process (SRS-010), within the Monitor Temperature component. The sentence appears in that process's own Processing section, and the request it emits is SRS-010's declared output H/C Request, consumed by Determine Status of All H/C Units (SRS-011).

answers.answer_text: Condition 2 holds when the current temperature T is outside the trigger band but within the overtemperature bounds: LO <= T < LT (heating needed) or UT < T <= UO (cooling needed). Where LT = TSET - TD and UT = TSET + TD (trigger deviation), and LO = TSET - OD and UO = TSET + OD (overtemperature deviation), with TSET the thermostat's temperature setting. All four values derive from the initialization file per SRS-005/SRS-006.

test_cases.title: Valid Equivalence Partition - Temperature T within [LO, LT) with Condition 2 True

steps: Set the current temperature T to 64°F (satisfying LO <= T < LT).
Trigger the Determine H/C Mode process.
test_cases.expected_result: The Determine H/C Mode process outputs an H/C Request to turn on the heating unit.
